input.sql:
SELECT s.CDSCode, s.School, s.SOC, s.GSoffered, s.GSserved, f.[Low Grade], f.[High Grade], f.[Enrollment (K-12)], f.[FRPM Count (K-12)]
FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC='66'
ORDER BY f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 20

SELECT f.[Low Grade], f.[High Grade], s.GSserved, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC='66'
GROUP BY f.[Low Grade], f.[High Grade], s.GSserved
ORDER BY cnt DESC

SELECT s.School, f.[FRPM Count (K-12)], f.[Enrollment (K-12)],
       ROUND(f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] / f.[Enrollment (K-12)], 4) AS rate
FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = '66'
ORDER BY f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5

SELECT s.School, f.[FRPM Count (K-12)], f.[Enrollment (K-12)],
       ROUND(f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] / f.[Enrollment (K-12)], 4) AS rate
FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.SOC = '66'
  AND f.[High Grade] != 'Adult'
ORDER BY f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5
